UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Private authenticated creator account profile storing non-public identity details and export count.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: Creator display name from Google profile.

exportCount.description: Cumulative count of weapon exports completed by this user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account record was last updated.

SavedWeaponBuild.title: SavedWeaponBuild
SavedWeaponBuild.description: A modular 3D weapon configuration saved to a user's personal cloud armory.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the build owner.

parts.description: Selected variant IDs for all 9 weapon slots.

dimensions.description: Parametric shape dimensions map in meters/degrees.

paints.description: PBR paint and wear settings keyed by weapon slot.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the build was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the build was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user account profiles indexed by Firebase Auth UID (strictly owner-readable/writable, no list queries).

/users/{userId}/builds/{buildId}.description: Private cloud armory weapon builds owned by {userId}.
